sar.narrative: Customer C00466, holder of card C00466-K1, is the subject of this suspicious activity report. Between 2016-11-21 20:00 and 2016-11-21 20:24, four online transactions totaling $1,860.43 were executed on card C00466-K1: $463.88 (transaction 3476601 at 20:00), $466.93 (transaction 3476621 at 20:07), $459.07 (transaction 3476655 at 20:22), and $470.55 (transaction 3476664 at 20:24). Each amount was kept just below a $500 authorization threshold and placed minutes apart to evade reporting requirements and controls. This activity is highly suspicious as it involves four online purchases within 24 minutes, each ranging between $400 and $500, with transaction 3476655 significantly exceeding the card's 95th percentile of $78.58 and median of $30.71. Furthermore, the card had one confirmed-fraud case in the 45 days prior to the alert under case CC-4662, indicating the card may still be compromised. The current pattern also closely resembles eight of the most similar closed confirmed-fraud cases, including CC-4124, CC-3907, CC-3841, and CC-4086. In response to these findings, the bank has executed a case creation and escalated the matter to an analyst, while recommending card blocking and filing this report.
